g.text: U26D / U27C / U27D are used on the Base interlock page.

g.desc: U26D / U27C / U27D are used on the Base interlock page.

g.text: R76-R81 default PWM LOW; R82 raw ENABLE default LOW.

g.desc: R76-R81 default PWM LOW; R82 raw ENABLE default LOW.

g.text: No MCU on this board; CTRL_READY must qualify ENABLE before any latch reset or DRIVE_PERMIT.

g.desc: No MCU on this board; CTRL_READY must qualify ENABLE before any latch reset or DRIVE_PERMIT.

g.text: C56-C61: 100 nF local bypass at each logic package.

g.desc: C56-C61: 100 nF local bypass at each logic package.

g.text: R76-R81: hold all six commands LOW while the controller is disconnected or Hi-Z.

g.text: R82: default disabled. R83: default no permission.

g.text: Logic levels remain 3.3 V; hardware AND gates operate independently of firmware.
